description: Comprehensive development ticket roadmap for a Texas-first utility/transmission permitting intelligence and workflow platform.
revision_notes: Incorporated expanded EPIC-00 tickets (T00-08 Jurisdiction Naming Standard, T00-09 Analyst SOP Manual) from updated submission.
Incorporated expanded EPIC-01 engineering bootstrap tickets (T01-05 through T01-13) from updated submission.
Moved Dataset Seeding & Ingestion Playbook from EPIC-08 to EPIC-02 (now T02-06) so real Texas data is available before rules engine and benchmark testing begin.
Added Auth, RBAC & Tenant Isolation (T01-14) to EPIC-01 to support multi-user consultant and enterprise workflows.
Added API Contract & Surface Design (T01-15) to EPIC-01 to formalize the boundary between rules engine and frontend/export layers.
Added PostGIS & Spatial Infrastructure Planning (T01-16) to EPIC-01 so hosting and CI/CD decisions account for spatial DB requirements before EPIC-05.
Added Consultant Frontend Shell & Navigation (T06-01) to EPIC-06; existing tickets renumbered T06-02 through T06-04.
Added Internal Frontend Shell & Admin Navigation (T08-02) to EPIC-08; existing tickets renumbered accordingly.
Added explicit dependency chains linking T00-06 -> T02-06 -> T04-02 and T01-16 -> T05-01.
Updated deferred list to include items present in agents.md but missing from prior JSON versions.
Added /effective rules directory to T01-05 monorepo structure, distinguishing published from currently-effective rules.
Added Data Freshness Scoring (T02-07) to EPIC-02 as a separate dimension from confidence tiers.
Added User Feedback Queue (T08-06) to EPIC-08 for analyst-gated consultant feedback.
Added operational risk buffer note to T02-06 (Dataset Seeding) as the highest-variance task in the roadmap.

epics.title: Product Architecture, Governance & System Design
epics.objective: Define the deterministic foundation of the platform before engineering implementation begins.

tickets.title: Define Regulatory Rule Object Specification
tickets.description: Design the canonical declarative rule format governing permits, triggers, thresholds, dependencies, jurisdictions, confidence tiers, provenance, and temporal activation logic.
requirements: Rules must be editable without deployments

tickets.title: Define Jurisdiction Ontology Model
tickets.description: Create the formal hierarchy and relationship structure for federal, state, county, municipality, ETJ, utility district, drainage district, river authority, and special jurisdiction logic.

tickets.title: Define Temporal Versioning Model
tickets.description: Design the historical evaluation framework allowing projects to be evaluated against regulations active during specific time periods.

tickets.title: Define Permit Dependency & Sequencing Model
tickets.description: Create the deterministic dependency system defining prerequisite permits, sequencing recommendations, parallel workflows, agency review dependencies, and likely review bottlenecks.

tickets.title: Define Explainability & Traceability Standards
tickets.description: Establish the output structure explaining why a permit triggered, which rule triggered it, applicable thresholds, jurisdiction source, source citations, confidence logic, and known unknowns.

tickets.title: Create Benchmark Project Test Suite
tickets.description: Develop historical benchmark projects used for regression testing, edge-case validation, deterministic output verification, and future rules-engine QA/QC.

dependencies.note: Benchmark definitions are created here as design artifacts. They become executable only after T02-06 seeds real regulatory data, and are validated continuously via T04-02.

tickets.title: Draft Engineering Handbook
tickets.description: Create the mandatory engineering handbook defining architecture standards, rules engine behavior, editing procedures, deployment safety, testing requirements, rollback procedures, and debugging workflows.
requirements: Explain how to safely edit functions
Explain how to safely modify permit rules
Explain how to avoid breaking deterministic outputs

tickets.title: Create Jurisdiction Naming & Normalization Standard
tickets.description: Define canonical jurisdiction naming, internal IDs, aliases, temporal jurisdiction validity, and geographic traceability standards.

tickets.title: Create Regulatory Analyst SOP Manual
tickets.description: Develop the operational SOP for source collection, normalization, rule drafting, validation, benchmark testing, peer review, publication approval, and emergency rule updates.

epics.title: Engineering Standards, Repository Bootstrap & Core Infrastructure
epics.objective: Build the maintainable engineering foundation enforcing long-term scalability and readability.

tickets.title: Configure Repository & CI/CD Environment
tickets.description: Establish repository structure, deployment pipelines, staging environments, branch standards, and code review standards.

tickets.title: Implement Engineering Constraints & Linters
tickets.description: Enforce maximum 60-line functions, readability standards, explicit logic, low-complexity functions, and maintainability-first architecture.
requirements: Functions must be easy for engineers to understand quickly

tickets.title: Establish Declarative Rules Repository
tickets.description: Build the version-controlled rule storage system ensuring rules remain editable without deployments, rule history is preserved, and auditability is maintained.

tickets.title: Implement Audit Logging Infrastructure
tickets.description: Create immutable logging for rule changes, reviewer actions, permit output modifications, publication history, and system evaluations.

tickets.title: Initialize Monorepo Structure
tickets.description: Create repository structure for backend services, rules engine, GIS services, frontend web app, analyst portal, shared schemas, infrastructure, documentation, benchmark projects, and regulatory operations tooling.

tickets.title: Establish Branching Strategy
tickets.description: Implement main, develop, feature branches, release branches, and hotfix workflow.

tickets.title: Configure GitHub Actions CI Pipelines
tickets.description: Implement automated linting, testing, function-length checks, schema validation, rule validation, regression testing, and deployment checks.

tickets.title: Build Environment Configuration System
tickets.description: Create local development config, staging config, production config, secrets handling standards, and environment variable standards.

tickets.title: Configure Infrastructure-as-Code
tickets.description: Set up Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent for database provisioning, spatial database provisioning, storage provisioning, backend service infrastructure, and CI/CD infrastructure.

tickets.title: Initialize Documentation Structure
tickets.description: Create documentation directories for architecture, rules, GIS, operations, analyst SOPs, testing, and engineering handbook.

tickets.title: Create Shared Schema Packages
tickets.description: Build shared models for rule objects, jurisdictions, GIS overlays, permit outputs, audit logs, benchmark projects, confidence tiers, and source provenance.

tickets.title: Configure Developer Experience Tooling
tickets.description: Implement pre-commit hooks, formatter standards, schema validators, local test runners, Docker development containers, and developer setup scripts.

tickets.title: Create GitHub Project Management Templates
tickets.description: Create issue templates, bug report templates, feature request templates, rule update templates, pull request template, CODEOWNERS, and contribution standards.

tickets.title: Implement Auth, RBAC & Tenant Isolation
tickets.description: Build authentication, role-based access control, and tenant isolation to support multi-user consultant workflows and enterprise access. Define roles for consultants, regulatory analysts, and platform admins.
requirements: Define role hierarchy: platform admin, regulatory analyst, consultant user

tickets.title: Define API Contract & Surface Design
tickets.description: Design the API boundary between the deterministic rules engine, GIS services, frontend applications, and export/deliverable layer. Define request/response contracts, versioning strategy, and error handling conventions.
requirements: Document error and advisory response structures

tickets.title: PostGIS & Spatial Infrastructure Planning
tickets.description: Evaluate and plan spatial database infrastructure requirements early so that hosting, CI/CD, and deployment decisions account for PostGIS or equivalent spatial DB needs before EPIC-05 implementation begins.
requirements: Document hosting requirements for spatial DB
Ensure CI/CD pipeline supports spatial extension testing
Identify managed PostGIS options vs self-hosted trade-offs

dependencies.note: This is a planning and decision ticket. Implementation of the spatial DB occurs in T05-01.

epics.title: Core Data Governance & Regulatory Intelligence
epics.objective: Build the regulatory intelligence backbone powering deterministic evaluations, and seed the initial Texas dataset.

tickets.title: Build Jurisdiction Hierarchy Database
tickets.description: Implement jurisdiction inheritance, overlap handling, alias support, canonical naming, geographic normalization, parent-child relationships, and temporal jurisdiction validity.

tickets.title: Develop Regulatory Intelligence Schema
tickets.description: Build the regulatory data structure storing permit metadata, agencies, forms, submission references, thresholds, citations, timelines, reviewer data, known unknowns, and advisories.

tickets.title: Implement Confidence Tier Framework
tickets.description: Build the Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 confidence classification system.

tickets.title: Implement Temporal Rule Activation Logic
tickets.description: Enable historical evaluations, effective-date handling, grandfathered evaluations, and archived rule replay.

tickets.title: Build Regulatory Source Tracking System
tickets.description: Track source URLs, statutes, ordinances, agency references, verification timestamps, superseded rules, reviewers, and confidence tiers.

tickets.title: Initial Dataset Seeding & Ingestion Playbook
tickets.description: Develop the structured workflow, templates, CSV/JSON schemas, and normalization standards required to translate initial Texas utility/transmission regulatory data into the live platform. This must complete before rules engine testing (EPIC-03/04) can use real data.

dependencies.note: Seeding depends on the schema and governance structures from T02-01 through T02-05. Rules engine testing and benchmark regression (T04-02) depend on seeded data being available.

tickets.move_rationale: Real regulatory data must be loaded before the rules engine (EPIC-03) and benchmark validation (EPIC-04) can be meaningfully tested.
tickets.operational_risk: This is the single highest-variance task in the roadmap. Translating real Texas utility/transmission regulatory knowledge into structured, normalized, citation-backed rule objects for the first time has no existing template to follow. Seeding velocity will set the pace for rules engine validation, benchmark testing, and downstream QA. Build scheduling buffer here.

tickets.title: Implement Data Freshness Scoring
tickets.description: Build a freshness scoring system separate from confidence tiers. A rule may be high-confidence but stale. Freshness tracks time since last verification, source URL reachability, form/submission process changes, and time since the source agency last updated the underlying regulation.
requirements: Track time since last analyst verification
Track time since source agency last updated regulation
Detect changed forms or submission processes
Trigger analyst review alerts independent of confidence tier
Display freshness score alongside confidence tier in permit outputs

epics.title: Deterministic Rules Engine
epics.objective: Build the explainable deterministic permit evaluation engine.

tickets.title: Build Declarative Rules Parser
tickets.description: Develop the deterministic parser capable of evaluating declarative regulatory logic, threshold conditions, jurisdiction inheritance, GIS triggers, and dependencies without hardcoded permit trees.

tickets.title: Implement Rule Evaluation Engine
tickets.description: Build the execution system evaluating project parameters, jurisdiction overlaps, thresholds, dependencies, and temporal rules.

tickets.title: Implement Rule Conflict Resolution System
tickets.description: Create deterministic conflict handling for overlapping jurisdictions, superseding requirements, contradictory thresholds, and nested jurisdiction overrides.

tickets.title: Build Permit Dependency Sequencer
tickets.description: Develop the deterministic sequencing engine recommending permit order, parallel actions, likely blockers, and agency coordination timing.

tickets.title: Build Explainability Engine
tickets.description: Generate traceable explanations for every permit trigger, including why it triggered, governing thresholds, applicable jurisdictions, citations, and confidence logic.

tickets.title: Implement Known-Unknown Detection
tickets.description: Build uncertainty logic identifying situations requiring consultant review, agency coordination, discretionary interpretation, or manual confirmation.

epics.title: Rule Validation, Simulation & QA/QC
epics.objective: Ensure deterministic outputs remain stable, explainable, and regression-safe.

tickets.title: Build Rule Simulation Engine
tickets.description: Allow simulated projects to run against historical rulesets, active rulesets, and hypothetical rule changes.

tickets.title: Implement Regression Testing Framework
tickets.description: Validate outputs against benchmark projects to detect unintended logic changes.

dependencies.note: Requires benchmark project definitions from T00-06 and seeded regulatory data from T02-06 to produce meaningful regression results.

tickets.title: Build Edge Case Testing Framework
tickets.description: Create automated testing for overlapping jurisdictions, conflicting triggers, ambiguous thresholds, and incomplete project data.

tickets.title: Implement Rule Diff & Change Analysis
tickets.description: Generate explainable comparisons between rule revisions, output changes, and jurisdiction impacts.

tickets.title: Build QA/QC Analyst Dashboard
tickets.description: Create internal tools for reviewing rule changes, validating outputs, approving publications, and tracking unresolved uncertainties.

epics.title: Lightweight GIS & Spatial Intelligence
epics.objective: Add jurisdiction-aware spatial intelligence without enterprise GIS complexity.

tickets.title: Integrate Spatial Database Infrastructure
tickets.description: Implement PostGIS, lightweight geospatial architecture, and overlay indexing. Follows infrastructure decisions made in T01-16.

dependencies.note: Hosting and deployment decisions from T01-16 must be finalized before standing up the spatial DB.

tickets.title: Build Shapefile & KMZ Ingestion Service
tickets.description: Allow footprint uploads, route parsing, geometry normalization, and geospatial validation.

tickets.title: Implement County & Municipality Detection
tickets.description: Automatically detect county intersections, municipalities, ETJs, and utility districts.

tickets.title: Implement Environmental Overlay Lookups
tickets.description: Build lightweight overlays for FEMA, watershed boundaries, USACE districts, and federal nexus indicators.

tickets.title: Integrate GIS-Driven Intake Modifiers
tickets.description: Dynamically modify intake workflows based on detected spatial jurisdictions.

tickets.title: Build Auto-Detection Review & Confirmation Workflow
tickets.description: After a user uploads a shapefile or KMZ, the system must automatically detect likely project jurisdictions and spatial overlays, then require user review before generating the permit matrix.
requirements: Allow the user to confirm results
Use confirmed values as the source of truth for the permit matrix
Manual entry must remain available as a fallback for early-stage projects without finalized route files

epics.title: Consultant Intake & Project Workflows
epics.objective: Build the consultant-facing intake system and workflow orchestration.

tickets.title: Build Consultant Frontend Shell & Navigation
tickets.description: Implement the primary consultant-facing web application shell including navigation, project dashboard, and layout framework. This is the container for all consultant-facing UI built in EPIC-06 and EPIC-07.
requirements: Responsive layout for desktop and tablet
Navigation between intake, permit matrix, deliverables, and project history
Integrate with auth and RBAC from T01-14

tickets.title: Build Dynamic Project Intake Form
tickets.description: Create adaptive intake forms responding to project type, uploaded shapefile/KMZ results, confirmed jurisdictions, GIS overlaps, utility categories, and federal nexus indicators.
workflow_priority: Manual entry fallback when no route file is available

tickets.title: Implement Texas Utility/Transmission Modifiers
tickets.description: Add Texas-specific utility logic including TxDOT, utility ROWs, transmission corridors, and utility district interactions.

tickets.title: Implement Project Persistence & Revision Tracking
tickets.description: Allow projects to save evaluations, preserve historical snapshots, compare revisions, and maintain audit history.

tickets.title: Build Permit Matrix Generator
tickets.description: Generate structured outputs containing likely permits, agencies, forms, timelines, sequencing guidance, and confidence tiers.

tickets.title: Implement Explainable Permit Outputs
tickets.description: Display trigger explanations, governing citations, source traceability, and uncertainty flags.

tickets.title: Enforce Liability & Advisory Framework
tickets.description: Apply mandatory advisory language and prevent authoritative compliance wording.

tickets.title: Build Exportable Deliverables Engine
tickets.description: Export Excel matrices, PDF summaries, proposal-ready tables, and audit-ready reports.

epics.title: Regulatory Operations & Human Review
epics.objective: Build the operational tooling required to maintain regulatory intelligence quality.

tickets.title: Build Regulatory Analyst Portal
tickets.description: Create internal dashboards for rule review, jurisdiction management, reviewer assignment, and publication workflows.

tickets.title: Build Internal Frontend Shell & Admin Navigation
tickets.description: Implement the internal-facing web application shell for regulatory analysts and platform admins, including navigation to analyst portal, QA dashboards, publication workflows, and rule health monitoring.
requirements: Navigation between analyst portal, QA/QC dashboard (T04-05), publication workflows, and monitoring views

tickets.title: Implement Source Expiration Monitoring
tickets.description: Flag stale citations, outdated forms, broken source links, and aging rules.

tickets.title: Build Regulatory Publication Workflow
tickets.description: Require analyst verification, approval chains, publication logs, and rollback capability.

tickets.title: Implement Rule Health Monitoring
tickets.description: Track frequently overridden rules, uncertainty-heavy outputs, user-reported conflicts, and stale jurisdictions.

tickets.title: Build User Feedback Queue
tickets.description: Create a structured feedback intake system allowing consultants to report incorrect triggers, outdated forms, bad jurisdiction detections, field-observed regulatory changes, and conflicting agency interpretations. All feedback enters an analyst review queue and must not auto-publish or bypass verification.
requirements: Support structured feedback categories: bad triggers, outdated forms, jurisdiction errors, field observations, agency conflicts
Route all feedback to analyst review queue
Must not bypass analyst verification or publication workflow
Track feedback resolution status and analyst response
Link resolved feedback to rule change audit trail where applicable

epics.title: Explainable AI Assistance
epics.objective: Add tightly constrained AI assistance while preserving deterministic authority.

tickets.title: Implement AI Document Extraction Pipeline
tickets.description: Extract project parameters from PDFs, reports, constraints documents, and site plans.

tickets.title: Build AI Proposal Language Assistant
tickets.description: Generate consultant proposal support text using deterministic permit outputs as the authoritative source.

tickets.title: Implement AI Workflow Recommendation Assistant
tickets.description: Assist consultants with sequencing explanations, workflow summarization, and review preparation.
requirements: AI must not override deterministic outputs

tickets.title: Implement AI-Assisted Regulatory Monitoring
tickets.description: Use AI to identify possible ordinance updates, changed forms, and modified submission processes.

deferred_from_mvp: Full OCR pipelines beyond constrained extraction
Advanced AI chatbot systems beyond constrained assistance
